projects.title: Fashion E-Commerce Web Application
projects.bodyText: A responsive fashion e-commerce frontend application developed using React.js and Redux. Features reusable React components, centralized state management, and responsive layouts using CSS Flexbox and Grid.

projects.title: Task Management Web Application
projects.bodyText: A task management application developed using React.js and Redux. Supports task creation, updating, deletion, and filtering with centralized state management and a responsive user interface.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.bodyText: A personal portfolio website developed using React.js and Redux to showcase professional details, technical skills, education, and projects. Built with modular components and a responsive layout.
